sections.indications_and_usage: Use for relief of occasional constipation (irregularity). Generally produces bowel movement in 6 to 12 hours.
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions Adults and children over 12 years of age - 1 to a maximum of 4 tablespoons (15 to 60 mL) in a single daily dose children 2 to under 12 years of age - 1 to a maximum of 3 teaspoons (5 to 15 mL) in a single daily dose children under 2 years of age - do not use, consult a doctor
